title: Adult walking constraints and causal locomotor-honesty boundary

scope.claimBoundary: Published results constrain active walking speed, joint-cycle frequency, motor-unit readiness, descending steering and touch-evoked reversal pathways. They do not supply a complete free-walking transfer or justify a plant-side collision behavior selector. Version 3.8 reports locomotion but does not claim spontaneous locomotor competence.

sources.title: Quantification of gait parameters in freely walking wild type and sensory deprived Drosophila melanogaster
A size principle for recruitment of Drosophila leg motor neurons

observations.interpretation: Slow units control low-force postural movements and can fire at rest. Population readiness is not an unconditional walking-velocity command.

sources.title: Inter-leg coordination in the control of walking speed in Drosophila

observations.speedControl: Walking speed is controlled predominantly through step frequency.
observations.coordination: High speed favors tripod coordination; slower walking can show tetrapod and wave-like patterns.

sources.title: Fine-grained descending control of steering in walking Drosophila

observations.rhythmOrigin: Rhythmic limb patterns originate in the VNC; descending commands start, stop, modulate speed and steer.
observations.bilateralRelation: Right-left differences in DNa01, DNa02 and DNg13 activity are linearly correlated with rotational velocity during walking.
observations.legGestures: DNa02 attenuates ipsilateral stride while DNg13 lengthens contralateral stride; neither is a generic forward-speed command.

sources.title: Neural circuit mechanisms for steering control in walking Drosophila

observations.DNa02: higher-gain, earlier and more transient steering predictor
observations.DNa01: lower-gain and more sustained steering predictor
observations.bilateralRelation: Rotational velocity is essentially linear over the right-left firing-rate difference; both cells hyperpolarize when walking stops.

sources.title: Descending networks transform command signals into population motor control

observations.forwardWalking: DNp09 recruits a broader descending network and that recruitment is required for complete forward walking.
observations.contextWarning: DNp09 stimulation can produce forward walking, stopping or freezing depending on stimulation/expression context; it is not a justified scalar velocity gate.

sources.title: Olfactory stimuli and moonwalker SEZ neurons can drive backward locomotion in Drosophila

observations.touchPath: Ascending mechanosensory neurons in the VNC activate MDNs to mediate touch-evoked backward walking.
observations.implementationConsequence: Contact belongs on the sensory side of the CNS loop; it does not justify a private body-plant reverse timer.

derivedConstraints.derivation: 28 mm/s multiplied by the 0.06 s representative plateau period. This remains a planar engineering scale, not a measured stride length for each leg.

motorDecoder.zeroRule: Exactly zero identified leg spike and subthreshold evidence produces exactly zero leg readiness.
motorDecoder.evidenceClass: provisional compensation for absent motor-neuron-specific intrinsic physiology

plant.gaitRule: Tonic leg readiness alone cannot start the transitional phase clock. A separate CNS coordination signal is required, and translation additionally requires identified leg traction.
plant.targetSpeedMmPerSecond: direction * gait frequency * 1.68 mm/cycle * stance traction
plant.steeringRule: Only explicit DNa02/DNa01/DNg13 bilateral evidence drives yaw; raw tonic left-right motor-pool imbalance does not.
plant.contactRule: Contact unloads the local leg and returns through the sensory packet. It never starts a plant-side reverse/turn timer or chooses an alternating escape side.

qualificationPolicy.engineeringGate: Causal invariants, integrity and report reproducibility must pass.
qualificationPolicy.scientificGate: Insufficient spontaneous steering, obstacle recovery or bout structure is preserved as a negative result. The default validation command must not convert those failures into a green competence claim.

knownLimitations: The broad descending coordination signal is still a transitional proxy and is not a validated phasic locomotor-recruitment population.
The homogeneous LIF model produces no spikes in the exact leg-motor, DNa, DNp09 or MDN populations during current default runs.
The planar shared phase clock and stance-traction transfer are not an articulated body.
Removing the plant reflex can expose obstacle fixation when the represented CNS fails to recruit MDN/steering output; this is an honest negative result.
No target coordinate, ideal action, random turn, collision timer, alternating escape side or anti-circling correction is introduced.
